title: A Compass for the Lantern
author: L. M. Blackwood
blurb: Silas Blackwood, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the census taker asks one question too many, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
